title: PowerShell Command Timeout - systemInfo Tool
problem: systemInfo command execution times out after 5 seconds, causing tool unavailability
cause: PowerShell process takes longer than timeout threshold. Likely caused by WMI/CIM queries in Get-ComputerInfo on first execution (cold cache)

recommended_actions.action: Increase PowerShell execution timeout from 5s to 15s for systemInfo
Cache WMI results to avoid cold-start delay on subsequent calls

notes: Framework-level issue: timeout configuration affects all slow-running tools
